goal: Read source/input.md, count how many lines begin with "## " using /usr/bin/grep -c, and write out/report.md whose first line is "headings=<count>" followed by the literal line "source=source/input.md". Return a record { headings: <the grep stdout string> }.

files.content:
# Title

## Alpha
body alpha

## Beta
body beta

## Gamma
body gamma

trailing note

notes: String concatenation with + is available; captured process stdout is a string.
file.write takes either content: <string> or sourceArtifact: <artifact id>.
